key_insight: VoroTypes automatically enumerates all likely Voronoi cell topologies for a crystal under small perturbations, enabling robust structural identification of complex crystals at the per-atom level.
engineering_relevance: It extends practical topology-based phase recognition in atomistic simulations from a few simple prototypes to complex, multi-sublattice structures used in materials engineering.
method: Takes a CIF or POSCAR crystal description as input
Uses exact symmetry reduction and validity pruning to speed enumeration
Exports topological filters directly for VoroTop and OVITO
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a precomputed library of filters spanning over a thousand Materials Project structures, demonstrating broad coverage rather than a single-case proof.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on the assumption of small generic perturbations and on the quality of the crystallographic input used to generate the filter.
paper_title: VoroTypes: automated enumeration of Voronoi cell topologies for structural identification of complex crystals in atomistic simulations
